newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLO/Bund spread seen stable till year-end.
newsitem.headline: OLO/Bund spread seen stable till year-end.

text.p: Belgian linear bond futures consolidated early gains on Wednesday and ended 28 basis points higher at 120.97 in line with Bund futures.

Ten-year OLO yields ended at 5.96 percent, down three bps, standing an unchanged nine bps over equivalent Bunds. Dealers said that as the Belgian Treasury would hold no further auctions this year, the OLO/Bund spread should remain stable at around current levels.
They said trade was minimal as most investors had closed their books for the year.
